description: Java class implementing a utility for integrating with Taxware tax calculation system, including data file creation, JNI call, and processing of tax adjustments.

classes.name: TaxwareUTL
classes.description: Utility class for handling tax calculations via Taxware, including data file management, JNI calls, and adjustment processing.

methods.name: TaxwareUTL
methods.description: Constructor initializing data files and loading native library.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process tax data, generate data files, invoke tax calculation, and handle output.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping amount for tax calculation.

methods.name: getItemAdjustments
methods.description: Returns list of item-specific tax adjustments.

methods.name: getOrderAdjustments
methods.description: Returns list of order-wide tax adjustments.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes data files and loads native library.

methods.name: makeItemData
methods.description: Prepares a record with static data and address info for tax processing.

methods.name: addStaticData
methods.description: Adds static configuration data from properties to a record.

methods.name: addAddresses
methods.description: Adds shipping address details to a record.

methods.name: createDataFile
methods.description: Creates a DataFile object from configuration XML.

methods.name: loadLib
methods.description: Loads the native tax calculation library.

methods.name: taxCalc
methods.description: Calls native tax calculation and processes the response.

methods.name: callTaxware
methods.description: JNI call to native tax calculation function.

methods.name: checkFields
methods.description: Validates that shipping info and items are set before processing.

methods.name: processOutFile
methods.description: Processes the output buffer from tax calculation, updates adjustments.
